The six poses form a continuous defensive resistance / bracing animation: 1) ready stance, 2) lower body braces downward, 3) forelimbs plant firmly forward and dig in, 4) body withstands kinetic force with tensed stance, 5) strain and slight effort pushback variation, 6) steady braced hold rooted in place. No collapse, no injury, no magic aura or shield bubble. Every pose fits comfortably inside the center 60% of its cell with wide empty magenta gutters separating them. No text, no panel lines, no ground plane, no drop shadows. Stylized sculpted painterly volumes matching the visual reference palette and style.
